expectations.evidence: The decision is framed vendor-first: the section is headed "So: which platform?" and both recommendations lead with brand names — "**LinkedIn Ads**" and "**Google Search**" — while the rejections are also vendor-named ("Not Meta or TikTok, and not broad Google Display"). The family labels themselves (paid search, paid social, B2B professional networks) never appear; "LinkedIn Ads" is even described as "the only major ad platform that lets you bias spend toward accounts," locking the reasoning to a specific vendor rather than to the targeting capability class.
